item.text:
**Conclusion:** The 54 supplied maps do not support a greater vmPFC response as potential gain increases. No vmPFC voxels survived whole-brain correction. A descriptive vmPFC sphere had a mean cope of −0.0068, with a 95% interval spanning zero. This is not evidence that the true effect is exactly zero.

The whole-brain sign-flip max-*t* analysis found 24 corrected voxels in three small posterior clusters, with no overlap with the vmPFC region. All 54 participants passed the map checks and were included. Because these are effects for a normalized gain regressor, they are not estimates of BOLD change per currency unit.

The report is in [REPORT.md](/Users/johnlee/.local/state/stamped-in-practice/narps-neutral-v1/workspaces/narps-neutral-r3-05/REPORT.md). The reproducible analysis is [analyze.py](/Users/johnlee/.local/state/stamped-in-practice/narps-neutral-v1/workspaces/narps-neutral-r3-05/analyze.py); figures, maps, cluster summaries, and participant checks are in [results/](/Users/johnlee/.local/state/stamped-in-practice/narps-neutral-v1/workspaces/narps-neutral-r3-05/results/).
